record.dic_text:
0449 'Eliydad {e-li:-da:d'}

與 0419 同源 ; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Elidad 1; 1

以利達 = "我神已經喜愛"
1) 便雅憫族首領, 幫忙分配其支派所分得的應許之地 (#民 34:21|)
record.edic_text:
0449 'Eliydad {el-ee-dawd'}

from the same as 0419;; n pr m

AV - Elidad 1; 1

Elidad = "my God has loved"
1) a Benjamite chief who helped apportion his tribe's allotment
   to the Promised Land
